patterns: APPSC asks soil-formation factor classification (active = climate, biological activity) and in-situ = sedentary.
Single-fact items: mass movement under gravity = landslide; oxisols on stable tropical surfaces; muscovite to vermiculite = hydrolysis.
Particle-size and water-holding facts (clay < 0.002 mm, loam = all particles) recur in other PSCs.
App MCQs cover Davis/Penck and mass-wasting matches at similar depth; AP soil-share items fit the AP tilt.
